event.value: Free professional advice, verdict first: after-action on every engagement shows the same first entry — the hero crossed the border armed. 'Every battle begins after you enter someone's territory. Draw the conclusion.' The protagonist saluted him as a fellow veteran of the coming war.

He reviewed the Witness Glass with the hero frame by frame — defenders telegraphing, civilians evacuating, restraint as drill — and the hero logged it as 'the enemy's theatrical arrogance'. Holt filed the misread like a casualty report.

notes: Modeled at the EARLY/default state: the free-professional-advice phase. He watches the Glass like after-action reports, so suspicion 40 is the highest among the hub regulars. Respect 15 is genuine and specific: the protagonist is brave, fit, disciplined — and wrong about the one fact that matters; professional admiration is a poor container for grief. Fear 15 is not of the man but of what he is watching: that the realms' restraint runs out before the hero's certainty does. Escalation per profile: mid-arc he runs after-action reviews; late-runs, parade-ground monotone. His breaking point is already visible on the Glass — trophy-hunting Heavy Hands is stripping badges off stretcher-bearers. Softens if the hero ever fights on the right side of a border. Deltas sum to current dimensions.
